title: Trail of Bits: Agent wallet key custody
raw_content: An AI agent that can sign transactions inherits the risks of the wallet it controls. Keys, spending limits, and contract permissions should be enforced outside the model output.

title: OWASP GenAI: Prompt injection
raw_content: OWASP documents prompt injection as untrusted input that can change an AI system's instructions. Agent tools with authority should enforce policy outside the model output before signing or taking action.
